spans.text: Operating Theater, Avernus.
All kinds of scary-looking surgical tools are still left strewn about an operating table covered in gore. It appears that they have not had time to clean and disinfect everything.
Vascular forcep, bone rongeur, brain suction tube, cerebellar retractor, and a hand-cranked cranial drill...
Cold and gleaming surgical instruments are lined up in front of her eyes, conjuring images of Ange's scalp being flayed and her brain being cut open.
Stop. Don't let your imagination run wild.
RO635 shakes off the unsettling thoughts and tries to match what she sees in the operating theater with the information she has found about the Hela Project.
Phenytoin is the green catheter... Droperidol is the red catheter...
RO635 mutters the names of the two drugs that Koleda just gave her as she searches for the right tubes.
I need to stop the administration of these drugs to get her to wake up.
The off switch...
Careful... Careful...
If I turn off the painkiller by mistake, it will cause her great pain.
Phenytoin... and droperidol.
RO635 finds the correct administration channels.
She flips the switch off with trembling hands—she is not as calm as she pretends to be.
Click.
When she returns to the white glass room, RO635 finds Koleda standing in front of the glass. She cannot glean any emotion from the Nyto's back.
A-anything?!
Now I'm starting to see just a tiny glimmer of hope.
Ange's fingers and eyelids are twitching.
Her vital signs have stabilized slightly—she is starting to stir.
We may actually be able to get her out of here.
Don't celebrate just yet, RO.
Our real work is just beginning.
You'll need to hack the database in Avernus. I need access clearance to the doors.
Including this one?
RO635 asks, pointing to the white room.
Especially this one.
